question: How do regulated-food practitioners offer breaths?
premises: Others with regulated food offer breaths into breaths
Prana rises as sound ending in om
Self-study and knowledge sacrifices are distinguished
inference: Breath offering purifies and destroys delusion
plain_english: Others with regulated food offer breaths into breaths; all sacrifice-knowers have sins destroyed, and prana rises as sound ending in om, distinguishing self-study and knowledge sacrifices.
